lockRule: Set lockedAt and the hashes below only after owner approval, a passed phase 1 and an accepted independent protocol review, and before any phase 2 cell. Any change after lock is a new version; earlier versions and their results are retained.
purpose: OS2: whether Context gives better accepted outcomes at lower complete model token cost than a competent ordinary workflow (and optionally Graphify) with the same frontier model in every arm.

buildUnderTest.repinRule: A phase 0 or phase 1 fix ships as its own release; this block is repinned before lock.

taskPack.shape: Eight tasks: four on bray and four on h3; per repository one orientation, impact, diagnosis and code-change task.

external.name: h3js/h3
external.test: vitest --run (not the package test script, which adds lint and typecheck)

taskPack.excluded: The eight d5-20260921 tasks are not reused: both repositories are ForgeSworn and the 0.4.0 fixes were found on that set.
taskPack.hiddenAcceptance: Required evidence, dependency set, checker and scope rules per task. Mined tasks take them from the merged change; the blind Claude session writes the rest and vets all. Hashes recorded here at lock; unread by the tool side, including the owner, until results are recorded.

source.impactAndCodeChange: Merged first-parent changes selected by history-candidates.mjs; the selecting session sees counts only.
source.preference: Most recent eligible changes first, to reduce memorisation.
source.orientationAndDiagnosis: Written by the blind Claude session, which also vets mined tasks.

offlineCheck.host: M4, macOS sandbox-exec denying outbound network except localhost and Unix sockets; profile verified to block outbound HTTPS and allow loopback first
offlineCheck.h3: 72 files passed, 1 skipped; 3112 tests passed, 69 skipped
offlineCheck.note: Rechecked for each task commit at freeze.

executor.invocation: absolute binary path with explicit flags, no shell, no inherited aliases
executor.harness: harness.py (derived from d5-20260921-v3/run-pair.py, which is unchanged); Context arm enables all seven 0.26.0 retrieval tools via `navigate <workspace>`

reviewer.blind: does not see arm name or other arms' output
reviewer.receives: answer or diff, checker result, private rubric, bounded excerpts of cited frozen source

arms.plain: Built-in shell, read and edit; no MCP server.
arms.context: As plain, plus the pinned 0.26.0 repository MCP server bound to the arm's prepared root; fresh server per arm.

graphify.description: As plain, plus a graph prebuilt with `graphify update <workspace>` (no model).
graphify.status: later round, not in this run

retrievalInstructionRule: Each arm's prompt begins with one retrieval instruction of similar length and force.
armOrderRule: Repetition r (1 to 3) of task i (1 to 8) uses the arm list rotated left by (i + r - 1) mod n, where n is the number of arms. Implemented in harness.py schedule().

steps: Packet sufficiency: deterministic check that a bounded packet holds each task's required evidence; record bytes; uncovered tasks are recorded gaps, not removed. Waits for the task pack.

Transcript metrics on Codex exec --json streams: metrics.mjs with fixture tests (done). September streams not found at the recorded path, so the metric is unvalidated on the known bad case; the write probe checks field names and phase 1 gives the first real measurement.
Harness: harness.py with 19 fixture tests (done): rotation, arm setup, no-alias rule, incomplete usage, cost gate and a dry-run plan. Five seeded bugs caught. Execution path waits for the task pack.
Offline tests for both repositories (done at the heads checked).
History candidates: history-candidates.mjs with tests (done; counts only).

writeProbe.purpose: Recheck the v2 read-only sandbox defect on the pinned Codex version.

phase1.cells: one impact or code-change task, plain and context, one repetition, one reviewer each
phase1.onFailure: Record; fix the observed cause as its own release; rerun phase 1 under a new draft revision. Phase 2 is not run.

phase2.cells: 8 tasks x 3 repetitions x 2 arms, plus one reviewer per cell

blindAuthor.session: fresh Claude session without the Context docs, skill or these prompts

metrics.readsAfterPacket: Distinct packet-covered files later read directly (cat, nl, head, tail, sed -n ranges, awk NR ranges) with a range overlapping one already returned by a packet, divided by distinct packet-covered files; no range means whole file; reads before the covering packet do not count. Implemented in metrics.mjs.
metrics.toolErrorRate: Failed or declined tool calls and MCP isError results divided by all tool results; a command that ran and exited non-zero is a nonZeroExit, not a tool error.
metrics.missedOrIncorrectDependencies: Counted after acceptance against the hidden dependency set, by checker and scope check; independent of acceptance (an accepted outcome can still miss a dependency) and never shown to executor or reviewer.
metrics.firstPassAccepted: Code-change checker passes on the executor's first self-check. Reported only.
metrics.totalTokens: Executor plus reviewer input and output, including cached input, setup, repairs and failed attempts.
metrics.searchesAfterPacket: rg, grep, git grep and find after the first packet; reported separately, outside the threshold.
metrics.unclassifiedSegments: Command segments the classifier does not recognise; reported.
usageAssumptions: per-turn, not cumulative, usage in turn.completed

qualityGate.rule: Per-task median lower than the comparator on at least two tasks and higher on none, with no Context outcome rejected.
qualityGate.perfectBaseline: No claim; a prospectively written harder task class replaces that class.
qualityGate.structuredAcceptance: Checker passed and blind reviewer accepted.

costGate.statistic: Sum over tasks of per-task median totalTokens
costGate.rule: Context at least 20% below each comparator, and sum of per-task median reviewerSeconds no higher.
costGate.reportedOnly: Geometric mean of per-task ratios with a 90% bootstrap interval (10,000 draws, seed fixed at lock).
costGate.accounting: Codex --json event stream usage; cached, uncached, output and reasoning subset reported separately, never added twice.
costGate.incomplete: Missing usage marks a cell incomplete, never zero; an incomplete cell in either compared arm fails the cost gate.
costGate.money: ChatGPT plan allowance: token reduction and plan headroom only; cash savings not claimed.

openDecisions: Separate approvals, in order: write probe, blind task-author session, phase 1, then protocol review and phase 2 only if phase 1 passes

ownerDecisions.repositories: bray (ForgeSworn) and h3js/h3 (outside); each task pinned at its own commit
ownerDecisions.arms: plain and context; graphify is a later round with its own approval, run only if the pair passes
ownerDecisions.hiddenSets: impact and code-change tasks taken from merged history (diff gives the dependency set, its tests give the checker); orientation, diagnosis and vetting by a fresh Claude session started without the global instructions that load the Context skill
ownerDecisions.billing: Codex reports "Logged in using ChatGPT": plan allowance, not metered; report tokens and headroom, no cash claim

repetitionsCells: 8 tasks x 2 arms x 3 repetitions = 48 executor cells, each with a reviewer
